intro: The Strawberry Ginger (22 oz) is a refreshing handcrafted beverage from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) that combines sweet strawberries with a zesty ginger kick. At 165 calories, this vibrant drink offers a perfect balance of fruity sweetness and spicy warmth. Made with simple, real ingredients including strawberries, ginger, cane sugar, and water, it provides a naturally energizing option to complement any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/).
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for a 22 oz serving, the Strawberry Ginger drink contains 165 calories. With 41g of carbohydrates, 0g of protein, and 0g of fat, this beverage offers a light refreshment option. The calorie count comes primarily from natural fruit sugars and cane sugar, making it a straightforward choice when planning your meal using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
whatMakesSpecial: This drink stands out for its unique combination of sweet strawberries and spicy ginger, creating a flavor profile that is both refreshing and invigorating. Unlike typical sodas or artificial drinks, it uses real fruit and ginger root. The natural ingredients provide authentic taste without artificial flavors or colors, making it a standout option on the beverage menu at CAVA.
nutritionFacts: Each 22 oz serving of Strawberry Ginger contains 165 calories with 41g of carbohydrates. The drink is fat-free and protein-free, focusing purely on refreshment. The carbohydrates come from natural fruit sugars and added cane sugar. With zero allergens and made from plant-based ingredients, it fits various dietary preferences including vegan and vegetarian lifestyles at CAVA.
whatsInside: The Strawberry Ginger drink features a simple ingredient list: fresh strawberries, ginger root, cane sugar, and water. The strawberries provide natural sweetness and vibrant color, while ginger adds a spicy, warming note. Cane sugar balances the flavors, and water creates the perfect consistency. This straightforward recipe ensures you know exactly what you are drinking with every sip.
tasteLike: The first sip delivers sweet, ripe strawberry flavor that immediately refreshes your palate. As the taste develops, you will notice a pleasant ginger warmth that adds complexity and depth. The ginger provides a subtle spicy kick without overwhelming the fruit sweetness. The overall experience is bright, energizing, and perfectly balanced between sweet and spicy notes.
customize: The Strawberry Ginger (22 oz) comes as a crafted beverage with a set recipe. If you prefer a smaller portion, consider the 16 oz size for fewer calories. You can request light ice for more beverage or extra ice for maximum chill. Pair it strategically with items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) or [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) to create your ideal meal combination.
pairsWell: This refreshing drink pairs excellently with Mediterranean bowls and pitas from CAVA. The ginger notes complement spicy harissa-based dishes, while the strawberry sweetness balances savory items from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). It also works well alongside grilled proteins and fresh vegetables. The bright, clean flavors help cleanse your palate between bites of rich, flavorful Mediterranean cuisine.
healthyChoice: At 165 calories for 22 oz, the Strawberry Ginger drink offers a moderate calorie option compared to many commercial beverages. Made with real fruit and ginger, it provides more natural ingredients than typical sodas. However, with 41g of carbohydrates primarily from sugars, it should be considered an occasional treat. Those monitoring sugar intake may want to check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for alternatives.
howToOrder: Order the Strawberry Ginger (22 oz) at any CAVA location by simply requesting it when placing your order. You can add it to any bowl, pita, or salad as your beverage choice. The drink is prepared fresh and served over ice. Find your nearest restaurant using [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this refreshing beverage with your favorite Mediterranean meal today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at 360 calories, the Strawberry Ginger offers significantly fewer calories at 165. The Blueberry Lavender (22 oz) has 190 calories, making Strawberry Ginger the lightest option among flavored drinks. While lemonade provides classic citrus tartness, Strawberry Ginger delivers unique fruit and spice complexity. Both Blueberry Lavender and Strawberry Ginger feature berry-forward profiles with distinctive flavor accents.
whoShouldTry: This drink is perfect for anyone who enjoys fruit-forward beverages with a twist. Ginger lovers will appreciate the warming spice notes, while strawberry fans get natural fruit flavor. Those seeking alternatives to plain water or soda will find this refreshing. Customers building meals from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) should definitely consider this unique beverage option.
worthTrying: The Strawberry Ginger (22 oz) is absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor combination and real ingredients. At $3.85, it offers good value for a handcrafted beverage made with fresh fruit and ginger. The 165-calorie count makes it a reasonable treat, and the distinctive taste sets it apart from generic drink options. It adds a special touch to your CAVA dining experience.
